properties.name: A0198/23 / TXKF
properties.originalText:
OVERFLYING OF RUSSIAN ACFT PROHIBITED. 
UKRAINE CRISIS: AIRSPACE RESTRICTION ISSUED BY BERMUDA CAA - NO ACFT 
WHICH IS OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY A PERSON CONNECTED WITH 
RUSSIA, OR WHICH IS REGISTERED IN RUSSIA SHALL FLY IN BERMUDA 
AIRSPACE, INCLUDING THE AIRSPACE ABV THE TERRITORIAL SEA. THIS 
REGULATION DOES NOT APPLY TO ANY ACFT FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE 
PERMISSION OF THE UK SECRETARY OF STATE FOR TRANSPORT. INFO@BCAA.BM
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境
